0.0: Heya, #b#h0##k. Many, many fwends have passed by me. I've always had my eye on you though! Beep boop!
0.1: Fwend... You seem like you could become an expert in Star Planet. So we, Beep Boop and Star Arena fwends have gathered to prepare a bunch of rewards for you. Want to participate in this 7 days of awesomeness?

0.msg: The event is quite easy. Simply complete the quests on each date during the event period! Complete them all and you can become the #bMini-game Master and Floppy's Apprentice#k!
